name: opennjob
description: OpennJob - AI job-application assistant (API, candidate web app, Chrome extension, domain core)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @opennjob/core && npm run build -w @opennjob/api && npm run build -w @opennjob/extension && npm run build -w @opennjob/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @opennjob/core && npm run typecheck -w @opennjob/api && npm run typecheck -w @opennjob/extension && npm run typecheck -w @opennjob/web
